# English teaching shaped around your goals

Whether you are working on your own spoken English or arranging training for a group, the starting point is the same: identify what matters, focus on it, and practise in context.

## Pronunciation coaching {#pronunciation}

One-to-one sessions for people who want to speak English more clearly, confidently and naturally.

We can work on:

- Individual sounds and the contrasts that matter for intelligibility.
- Word stress, sentence stress and rhythm.
- Connected speech, including how words change when people speak naturally.
- Listening awareness and strategies for understanding different English accents.
- Pronunciation in the situations where you actually need to use English.

Sessions are tailored to your existing English, priorities and goals. The aim is effective communication, not accent elimination.

**Format:** Online or in person — edit to reflect your offering.

**Rate:** €[ADD RATE] per hour. Please enquire about paired sessions.

## Professional communication {#professional-communication}

For professionals and postgraduate students who need to participate confidently in English-speaking environments.

Possible areas of focus include:

- Speaking up and contributing in meetings.
- Presentations and explaining complex ideas.
- Networking, coffee chats and informal professional conversation.
- Interview communication.
- Clear, tactful and effective spoken interaction with colleagues and clients.

We can build sessions around real scenarios from your studies or work.

## Workshops {#workshops}

Practical workshops for universities, employers and organisations working with international students or multilingual teams.

Possible workshop themes include:

- Pronunciation and intelligibility for international English users.
- Spoken communication in academic and professional settings.
- Meetings, networking and informal workplace conversation.
- Presentation skills and spoken fluency.
- Understanding variation across English accents.

Workshop content, length and format can be adapted to the group and its needs.
